(3) Back on the balcony, the woman continues her enthusiastic intro, pointing at herself and gesturing outwards. (4) The scene shifts to an outdoor urban area where the woman is interviewing another woman wearing sunglasses and a grey t-shirt; they are sitting on a stone ledge. (5) In a new outdoor scene by the beach, the woman stands with two young men; she holds a small black microphone. (6) The woman sits on concrete stairs next to a young boy in a white hoodie, engaging him in conversation. (7) The woman stands on the beach with two young Japanese men; she gestures while talking, and the ocean is visible behind them. (8) The woman is now on the sand, offering a container of small round snacks to a couple sitting on the beach, and then to a man wearing a green hat. (9) The camera returns to the woman on the balcony, who speaks directly to the camera with high energy. (10) A brief indoor scene shows the woman at a desk with a laptop and a brown tabby cat being held up to her face; she then looks at a smartphone. (11) The final shot is back on the balcony with a 'Speak' logo overlaid on the center of the frame.
